The '''''Pearl's Girl''''' was a [[Hover barge/Legends|hoverbarge]] serving as [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of the [[Ravagers]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] gang. It was used as their headquarters together with their cove in [[Raider's Cove]], on [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]], where the ship was usually docked. In [[3637 BBY]] a team of [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] heroes [[Raid against the Ravagers|attacked]] the Ravagers's base in Raider's Cove, so many pirates boarded the ''Pearl's Girl'', trying to leave the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] surface, but the team managed to board the ship before the take off.

Aboard they faced the Chief Engineer [[Torque (pirate)|Torque]], who was defending engine room. The [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] tried to destroy engine controls around him, in order to kill the invaders, but they were faster than him and managed to kill him. When the heroes reached the aft deck, other Ravagers ships started to hit the ''Pearl's Girl'', seeing it compromised. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Blaster (droid)|Blaster]] and his maker [[BO-55|Master]] tried to stop the invaders, but they failed and were deactivated.

Returning inside the ship, the heroes arrived to command bridge, where [[Coratanni]] and her pet [[Pearl (flutterplume)|Pearl]] had a last attempt to kill the heroes. When both the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] and the best were seriously injured, they left the bridge in an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] and reached another room. There Coratanni died, while [[Ruugar]], who had asked the team to clear the Ravagers's cove, betrayed them. He was killed, and the heroes ultimately left the ''Pearl's Girl'', landing on a small island. The ship crashed on the sea, destroyed by flames.<ref name="TR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Pearl's Girl'' appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' Operation "The Ravagers" as background of the second half of the quest. Its name is taken from Pearl, Coratanni's pet.
